scope.operation: Retain OLE2FRAME and OLEFRAME callback values in the concrete BLOCK adapter and route them through the existing typed DXF serializers.
behavior: Typed capture rejects a callback whose public eType disagrees with its concrete OLE frame type.

Retained-byte accounting charges OLE2 client text, source raw bytes, and DXF payload bytes; legacy OLE charges source and DXF payload bytes. The copy remains subject to the adapter aggregate record/byte limits.
BLOCK export dispatch runtime-checks the stored type before calling writeOle2Frame or writeOleFrame.
Generated ASCII and Binary named-BLOCK readback checks both payload byte sequences and OLE2 version, client, frame points, flags, mode, and lock-aspect metadata.

limitations: The round-trip uses locally authored in-memory values and does not establish external producer or native OLE consumer semantics.
Retaining and emitting OLE payloads does not establish complete enclosing document output or support for every OLE profile.
